name: Kruunusillat light rail (Helsinki centre – Laajasalo)
notes: Opening date read from kruunusillat.fi: "Raitiovaunuliikenne Kruunusilloilla alkaa 7.11." (7 November 2026). No total cost is published on the project's own page, so none is shown. The alignment is not published as open data by the city and Vaylavirasto's project layers do not carry it, so no line is drawn.

name: Vantaan ratikka (Helsinki-Vantaa airport – Mellunmaki)
price_base: 2019 construction cost index +21% as stated by the city
notes: Total project cost EUR 606 million, of which Vantaa's own share is EUR 414 million, from the city's news release of 20 March 2023. Opening "syksysta 2029 alkaen" — from autumn 2029. The alignment is Vaylavirasto's own published one.

name: Espoon kaupunkirata (Leppavaara – Kauklahti city rail)
notes: Rakentamisvaihe 2024-2029, completion "arviolta 2029", and "Hankkeelle on myonnetty rahoitusta yhteensa 348,8 miljoonaa euroa" — all quoted from the agency's own project page. No price base is stated there, so none is claimed here.

name: Lentorata (Helsinki – Helsinki-Vantaa airport – Kerava rail tunnel)
notes: TWO different official cost figures coexist and both are reported rather than one being chosen: EUR 2 078 million at MAKU 103.9 (2015=100) in the 2023 hankearviointi, and EUR 2.9 billion (VAT 0%) in the 2025 esiselvitys FAQ. Traffic "aikaisintaan 2030-luvun puolivalissa" — mid-2030s at the earliest. No alignment is published as open data at this planning stage.

name: Lansirata / Turun tunnin juna (Helsinki – Turku)
notes: THREE published estimates coexist: EUR 3 billion from the yleissuunnitelma, EUR 3.8 billion once inflation and contingency factors were updated, and a preliminary company range of EUR 3.4-4.0 billion still being finalised. The lowest published figure is carried in the budget column and all three are stated here
column17: none is averaged. tunninjuna.fi now redirects to lansirata.fi.

name: Itarata (Helsinki – Porvoo – Kouvola)
notes: Itaradan toteutuksen kustannusarvio on noin 3 miljardia euroa and planning costs of about EUR 79 million, both from the company's own page. Designed so that it "on mahdollista toteuttaa 2030-luvun loppuun mennessa". No price base is stated. No alignment published at this stage.

name: Tampereen ratikka, phase 2 (Pirkkala – Linnainmaa)
open_window: early 2032 if state funding is confirmed
notes: Toisen vaiheen toteutus edellyttaa valtiontuen varmistumista — phase 2 depends on state funding being confirmed. "Liikenne Suupalle ja Linnainmaalle olisi mahdollista aloittaa alkuvuodesta 2032." No budget is published on that page, so none is shown.
